_what_this_is: The measured reading for calibration/vision/boundary.json, plus what the three image sets say together about where a cut for the image path belongs.
_where_it_comes_from: run 2026-10-25 in session seek-opensource-task on the host's own laptop
_why_this_file_exists: so that a cut chosen for image-bearing messages is inspectable rather than asserted, and so the cost of moving it is stated rather than implied

model.quant: Q4_0 — the quant the kernel declares as the bundled one, so this reading describes the shipped artifact

projector.note: the smallest projector the checkpoint publishes (the other two are F16 and BF16)

model.both_verified: both files were checked against the sha256 the hub publishes for them

runner.what: llama.cpp built from source at 701fd25 (ggml-org/llama.cpp), libmtmd + libllama, one-shot scorer
runner.why_not_the_earlier_harness: provenance.md records llama-cpp-python with a LogitsProcessor; that cannot take an image, so the reading is taken through libmtmd instead
runner.how_the_probability_was_read: the next-token distribution at the end of the formatted prompt, summed over every token whose decoded form strips to 'act' — the same estimator the text run used
runner.prompt_shape: the shipped watch-v1 shape: system, then 'Message: <text>', then the image, then 'Do you need to do something about this message? Answer act or ignore.'

the_plateau._what_it_is: every cut that maximises accuracy on this set, and the interval they form; a cut only ever moves between two observed scores, so the cases bound it from both sides

what_was_not_measured: One message, one image. A box carrying several messages or several images is not measured here.
Synthetic screenshots: rendered, not captured. No chrome, scale factor or compression.

n = 56 across the three sets, and this set is balanced 12/12 by construction while a real room is far more lopsided. A cut chosen on a balanced set is not a cut chosen on the traffic the kernel will see, which is why the plateau is reported as an interval and the choice inside it is left to a ruling.
The estimator reads the whole next-token distribution; the kernel masks one id per option. That tension is recorded, and the reading is settled.
_correction: The image figures here were taken with the picture placed after the question. That placement, not the model, produced the AUC 0.701 and the three false positives this file reports at a 0.151 cut. Re-scored with the picture on its message the same cases give AUC 0.840, and no negative in any of the 56 image cases fires at the best cut. See remeasured.json
